verdict.rationale: Post-Incident Reviews explicitly 'coordinate preventative follow-up actions' and integrate with incident lifecycle and Slack data (docs-36, docs-38), showing follow-up tracking is a native capability. However, there is no concrete evidence of a documented sync mechanism that pushes these follow-up items into an external issue tracker (e.g., Jira, GitHub Issues) — only a generic claim of '750+ platform integrations' (docs-50) without specifics on follow-up-action sync. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of two-way sync between PIR follow-up items and an issue tracker, and confirmation that completion status flows back to PagerDuty.
